result.title: Self-Improving Long-Horizon Reasoning by Learning Summaries from Local Continuations
result.summary: Reasoning models degrade as their context grows, so longer reasoning traces do not by themselves give longer effective horizons. One way to extend the horizon is to compress the reasoning history into a compact state from time to time and continue from the state. Existing methods train the state with the final-answer reward or distill it from a stronger model. Neither signal is tailored to measure the contribution of the state alone. We observe that a reasoning model that degrades over long trajectories still behaves reliably in short contexts. We aim to preserve this short-context behavior when compressing the reasoning history. Motivated by this, we train a separate summarizer with Delta-KL, a reward computed from the frozen reasoning model's token-level predictions on sampled continuations, and run inference by truncating the trace, summarizing it, and continuing from the summary (TruSuCo). Training uses a few thousand questions with 4k-token reasoning prefixes and does not need answers or external teachers. Under a fixed 32k-token budget, the trained summarizer improves on vanilla reasoning and on an untrained summarizer in all nine settings across mathematical benchmarks and Reasoning Gym puzzles, by up to 7.7 points and 12 points, respectively. The improvement over vanilla reasoning grows with the budget. At 128k tokens, our method outperforms it by 10 points on AIME 2024--2026. Analyses show that truncation prevents the collapse of vanilla reasoning and that the trained summaries retain more of the reasoning history.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对长程推理中上下文增长导致性能退化的问题，提出截断推理轨迹、将其压缩为摘要状态并从摘要继续推理；同时训练独立摘要器，以冻结推理模型在采样续写上的 token 级预测构造 Delta-KL 奖励，无需答案或外部教师。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「压缩历史为状态并从状态续推」以及仅衡量状态自身贡献的 Delta-KL 监督，与 LVR 关注的 latent 状态信息保留、信息坍缩和贡献分配可能直接相关，可供核查；但论文面向纯文本推理，迁移到多模态状态仍需验证。
